cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: I Know How to Win This
cards.instruction: Perform mastery of the rules, odds, and consequences while improvising every decision.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've calculated our optimal raffle move. Leave the tickets to me; I'll decide when we buy.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You buy one ticket. That's all there is to it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One at the right moment. You may count the tickets while I assess when the winning one becomes available.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're shuffled in a bag. Buying later won't show you where any ticket ends up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we buy now. The shuffle removes timing from the equation, exactly as my first check required. Hand me the money; I'll let randomness do the part I've assigned it.
